tools.name: list_tours
tools.description: List Full of Joy private tours from Zagreb (day trips and multi-day journeys) with duration, options and starting prices. Use the returned tour key in the other tools.

tools.name: get_tour
tools.description: Full details of one tour: options with inclusions and exclusions, languages, duration, page URL and price tiers.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check which dates are open for a tour and the indicative price for a group size. Give one date, or a range (date_from and date_to, at most 62 days).

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Send a booking request to Full of Joy for one tour, date and group. This is a request, not a confirmed booking: the team checks the date and replies to the traveller by email, usually with the final price. No payment is taken. Only call this after the traveller agreed to share their name and email.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tour · Private data: list_tours · Public sink: request_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tour · Private data: list_tours · Public sink: request_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
